book.name: John
book.title: John ka Te Pabe'e Jesus Te Naa Tooa'a-witu Numu oo Tuukwena

content: Soo Te Pabe'e ka yadooamakwuse toogoopatu poonnese nanesootuhikooha, “E Naa, pudusoo umu e wohomu e batsakwu. Mu numu tunesootabue, nu togesapa u besa dooa. Nu yise punno'o ewow numu u-matoo nanesootuhi mayugwekwu.

U no'oko numu moohedu e mayugweke. Tooe haga tooe e naka'oedyuku u mayugwepu, nu punno'o ooosapa mu gwetzoimokwuna mu sootuhikwu, u numu manumudoopu nu yise Jesus Mu Pabe'e. Mu numu taka soo'oedyukudu ooosapa gwetzoimokwu.
Nu no'oko nuka u tunetammakuna yaa teepu-koobatu mamakwu. Ooonne'yoona mu numu besa u nemadabuekwu nu-koobatoo.
O'nosoo gisoo ka teepu namadabu'e, ta nabaa'yoona, nawa'ne'yoosoo.
U mu numu-matoo nuka naka'oedyuku mayugweke. Nu yise punno'o ume mu nakasopedakwadoo tunedyooe.
Umu ume doodooamuna, u yise nugatu mu mayugweke. Umu ume nakabetse'a, umu tuwazoo u naka'oedyukute, u yow no'oko hemma e nemadabuekute.
No'oko nuka u tunedyooepu nu mu numu tunedyooekwu. Umu oo naka'oedyukuna, oo sopedakwatoo nu u-baa'yoona yaa teepu-kooba petu, umu tuwazoo oo naka'oedyukute, u yaatoo e taya.
Nu umu nuka naka'oedyukudu, suu'mu nanesootuhikute u sakwa mu sootuhi.
U ka mu nu-matoo nanesootuhidu doodooamu-ga'yoo. Umu ka ume doodooamuna, nuga doodooamu tuwazoo. Ka taga doodooamu besa manakwe mu numu oo sopedakwadookwu, nu tookwa besa'yoo.

Pudusoo nu ka yaa teepu-kooba'yoona mease u-baasoo petugakwu. Pana umu e naka'oedyukudu, togesoo yaa teepu-kooba'yookwu. E Naa, u ooosapa besa'yoo. U unu poohagana, ka umu taka naka'oedyukudu mesoo mabetsea. Umu yise sumu-kwa'ne'yookwu, ta-kwa'ne, ta puu nawa'nesoo.
Too'e no'yoona umu-matu togesoo e naka'oedyukute, u tunetamma-wa'nesoo. Nu ka umu-baa'yoona suta-makoo mu mabetseayakwe. Sumu'yoosoo nana nu oemota manekwu. Pudusoo oosoo kadoo'oo namayugwekwu.
Pudusoo nu u-matoosoo kodyukakwu. Nu togesoo yaa teepu-kooba'yoona u-matoo nanesootuha'e, u ka umu nuka naka'oedyukudu sootuhikwu. Umu ka pumme u sootuhise besa sokwamakwu, nu-kwa'nesoo.

Nu ka u unnepu-witu mu tuukwe'e. Mu gi tunaka'oedyukudu ka mu taka naka'oedyukudu gi petzape, umu taka naka'oedyukudu ka nu-kwa'ne'yoona, gi umu-wa'ne'yoona. Umu e naka'oedyukudu gi ka taka wohonedu-kwa'ne'yoo. Nu mee nanesootuha'e ka suta-makoo ka yaa teepu-koobatu mabetsea mee, gi u, umu taka naka'oedyukudu gi eka teepu-koobakoo ta'ya. Soo taka naka'oedyukudu gi ooosapa ka teepu-kooba'yookwu nu-kwa'nesoo.
U umu taka naka'oedyukudu ka u unnepu naka'oedyukudu, ka togesapa oo na'unakwe, umu u tubetse nakabetseakwu. U yaa teepu-koobatoo e taya.
Meno'o yise nu ka umu tunaka'oedyukudu tayakwu, umu ka no'obatusoo numu u unnepu tunedyooekwu.
O'no umu, u nakabetseakwu nu-kwa'nesoo, nu pudusoo umu-koobatoo nabatsakwu, o'no yise umu u tubetse nakabetseakwu.
Umu taka naka'oedyukudu sootuhi. Nu-kwitu ka numu nanekwuhana nakadu sootuhi, o'no umu e naka'oedyukukwu.
Ta nanosoo sumu-kwa'ne'yookwu, no'oko umu taka naka'oedyukudu mayugweke. Umu ta-no manese, mu numu oo sopedakwadookwu ka yaa teepu-koobatoo nuka u tayase.
U puu u yadooawabe ka yaa teepu-kooba'yoona e mayugwepunne, umu taka naka'oedyukudu punno'o nuga yadooawabe manepunne. Umu punno'o sumu-kwa'ne'yookwu, ta-kwa'ne, ta puu nawa'ne'yoosoo.

Nu puu umu-no, u yise punno'o nu-nosoo. Umu yise sumu-kwa'ne'yookwu, ta-kwa'ne, ta puu nawa'ne'yoosoo. Ooonne'yoona mu gi tunaka'oedyukudu sakwa oo nakasopedakwatoo u yaatoo e taya, u ka umu taka naka'oedyukudu besa nanasoobedya mu mayugwekese nuka u soobedya-kwa'nesoo.

U, E Naa, ooosapa besa e soobedyadu, gisoo ka teepu namadabue sapa. U ka mu numu taka naka'oedyuku mayugwepu, o'no umu ta-baa ooosapa gwetzoimokwu. O'no umu ta-nawa'ne'yoo mee ta unnena nakasopedakwadookwu, yise taka nesookwugikwu.
U tubetse besa'yoo. Mu gi tunaka'oedyukudu yaa teepu-koobatu u-kwitu gi sopedakwadoo, nu suu'mu no'oko hemma u-kwitu sopedakwatoo.
Nu u-kwitu besa mu tuukwepu, yise ooosapa u-kwitu mu tuukwennummekwu. Nu ooosapa umu-no'yookwu, o'no yise umu besa nanasoobedyakwu nuka u soobedya-kwa'ne.”
